ai.summary: An adviser to the EU’s top court said Google’s Gemini could infringe publishers’ rights in some circumstances when it reproduces recognizable press content or accesses it by bypassing technical barriers. The opinion is not binding; it also says copyright rules permit using protected material to train large language models under the text-and-data-mining exception.
ai.title: Google AI chatbot's use of press items may infringe copyright rules, EU court adviser says

ai.summary: Anthropic’s amended IPO filing showed third-quarter revenue of $16.96 billion, up 47% from the prior quarter, and a net loss of $23.29 billion. It also disclosed roughly $895 billion in AI-computing commitments and warned that partners’ financing difficulties could delay or reduce promised capacity.
ai.title: Anthropic revenue growth slows, compute financing risks mount ahead of IPO

ai.summary: A senior Chinese financial regulator said AI investment is overly concentrated, potentially crowding out traditional businesses by raising borrowing costs and increasing credit risks. The official called for policy frameworks to address the financial risks of the AI-driven shift.
ai.title: AI investment is becoming overly concentrated, Chinese official says

ai.summary: Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in a $115 billion stock transaction, including debt, betting that optical networking will be crucial to AI data-center expansion. The proposed deal would be one of the largest tech acquisitions on record.
ai.title: Driven by AI boom, chipmakers announce $115 billion merger

ai.summary: Financial leaders said AI-related infrastructure demand is driving companies to seek more capital, while warning that heavy spending could leave the industry exposed to a correction. Combined AI spending is projected to exceed $730 billion this year, according to the report.
ai.title: Big-ticket tech deals need to keep pace with AI boom but risks remain high, financial leaders say

ai.summary: Alibaba and rival Chinese e-commerce platforms are selling AI usage credits as a major Singles’ Day product category for the first time. Alibaba said sales of AI token plans rose sharply in October, while a livestream promotion sold 100,000 memberships to its QwenWork office AI service in half an hour.
ai.title: China's 'Lipstick King' touts AI tokens in first for Singles' Day festival

quantum.summary: German startup Quint Computing raised €9.1 million in a funding round led by Vsquared, alongside a €2.2 million European Innovation Council grant. It is developing superconducting chips intended to suppress errors in hardware; the company’s projected 100-fold reductions in system overhead are its own claims, not demonstrated results.
quantum.title: Quint Computing raises €9.1M to scale quantum computing technology

quantum.summary: Researchers reported a fault-tolerant error-correction code for constant-excitation qubits, with simulations accounting for both stochastic and correlated coherent noise. The work evaluates a distance-3 code under circuit-level noise, but is a theoretical/simulation result rather than a hardware demonstration.
quantum.title: Researchers Build Fault-tolerant Code For Constant-excitation Qubits

quantum.summary: A Technical University of Munich team reported a neural-network-based superconducting-qubit readout method that maintained high fidelity with shorter measurement traces. In the team’s reported tests, the approach reduced logical error rates by up to 26% at a 500-nanosecond readout duration.
quantum.title: Mamba Model Reduces Qubit Error Rate 26%

quantum.summary: Researchers introduced a physics-informed denoising network for variational quantum algorithms, reporting performance comparable to zero-noise extrapolation while requiring roughly four to six times fewer circuit executions. The results are benchmark-based and address the measurement overhead of error mitigation.
quantum.title: New Network Cuts Circuit Executions For Quantum Error Mitigation

quantum.summary: FaultScope, a classical simulator for quantum error-correction circuits, estimates logical error rates and their sensitivities from shared simulation data. Its authors say those sensitivities identify circuit components that contribute disproportionately to errors, potentially helping researchers target improvements.
quantum.title: FaultScope Software Pinpoints Errors In Quantum Error Correction Circuits

quantum.summary: IBM Research reported meter-scale quantum interconnects linking two 120-qubit processors. The work focuses on connecting larger quantum processors, an important hardware challenge for scaling beyond a single chip.
quantum.title: Quantum Interconnects Link Two 120-Qubit Processors
